item.summary: fix(agents): apply per-agent contextTokens cap to embedded run context budget (#120343) * fix(agents): honor per-agent context budgets Apply the selected agent contextTokens ceiling to embedded-run prechecks, effective model sizing, compaction, safeguard sizing, and result metadata. Prepared attempts now carry one canonical budget into extension setup instead of re-resolving mutable policy. Caller-requested compaction budgets remain bounded by both the selected agent cap and the model window. Native model-owned harnesses continue to own their context and compaction policy. Refs: #118678 Co-authored-by: harjoth * test(agents): type compaction model fixtures --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
